Title: The Hot Highway

Who's who

अर्जुन - 34 years, friend
Look: cream shirt, sunglasses on his head
कबीर - 33 years, friend
Look: blue jacket tied round his waist
समीर - 32 years, friend
Look: brown sweater over his shoulders

Locations

1. the highway - a long empty road, dry fields, a single tree
2. the dhaba - wooden cots, a clay stove, open sky behind it

Equipment

1. car - an old white car
2. water jug - a big steel jug of cold water
3. spare tyre - a black spare tyre

The story begins

Episode 1 - the highway - Afternoon

The sun is blazing. Heat waves rise from the road. The white car stops with a bang.

कबीर (angrily): ''Flat tyre! In this heat! Who forgot to check the spare?''

समीर gets out and wipes the sweat from his face.

समीर (tired): ''Not me.''

अर्जुन lifts the water jug and pours cold water over his own head.

अर्जुन (laughing): “Ahh! Now I can think again.”

Episode 2 - the highway - Late afternoon

कबीर and समीर change the tyre. अर्जुन walks across the road and back with the spare tyre.

The three friends push the car together. It starts with a roar.

समीर (shouting): “It's alive!”

Episode 3 - the dhaba - Sunset

The sun sets behind the dhaba. The sky turns orange and pink.

The three friends walk side by side towards the wooden cots and sit down.

अर्जुन (softly): “Look at that sky. We drove six hundred kilometres today, fixed a tyre in the middle of nowhere, and nobody fought.”

कबीर (with a wink): ''Yet.''
